step1.description:
From the outside, watching the ark of JavaScript Frameworks over the past 15 years is probably a pretty confusing one. I believe we are at a critical point in front-end web development right now that we haven't seen of this nature in over a decade. So let's look at how we got here, and what drives us to where we are going today.
